toolCallDetails.arguments: {"path":"snake_openai-gpt-5.6-terra_01.html","edit_description":"Create this new standalone single-file HTML/CSS/JavaScript classic Snake game. Use a visually polished dark arcade interface. The game board must be an actual 30x30 grid rendered in canvas or DOM. Include a start menu overlay offering exactly three selectable modes: Human vs Human, CPU vs Human, CPU vs CPU, with descriptions and keyboard/click selection. During gameplay show scores for both snakes and controls. Snake 1 uses Arrow keys when human; Snake 2 uses WASD when human. Snakes move continuously, grow after eating food, lose on wall collision, self collision, or collision with the other snake. Have a fair simultaneous movement update so head-to-head behavior is handled; food respawns only in empty cells. CPU snake should reliably automatically search for food using safe pathing: prioritize valid moves that reduce Manhattan distance to food, avoid all occupied cells/walls, and fallback to viable moves with more open surrounding space; ensure it cannot reverse direction. Render distinct cyan and magenta snakes, food in amber, grid subtly. Present a game-over overlay declaring winner or draw and final scores. Allow restarting with Space, Enter, or R and returning to mode menu with M. Support responsive scaling, touch-friendly on-screen direction pad for player 1 and sufficient accessibility labels. Avoid external dependencies; all CSS and JS must be in this one file."}
